description: This source file defines the class MqttPublishTarget, which represents an MQTT message publishing target with a specified topic. It provides methods for creation, equality checks, and string representation.

classes.name: MqttPublishTarget
classes.description: An immutable class representing an MQTT publish target with a specific topic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new MqttPublishTarget instance with the given topic.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Returns the MQTT topic associated with this target.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the topic.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on the topic.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including the topic.
